//LanguageModel.tuning: Common, group-owned - every agent shares this. Model/ThinkingBudget/TimeoutSeconds/TotalBudgetSeconds below are tuned against the live API (2026-09-21), not guessed: gemini-3.5-flash measured ~5x faster than 3.6 on the same key and prompt, ThinkingBudget must sit under thinkingConfig (thinkingLevel is a 400 on this API version), and TotalBudgetSeconds is 3x TimeoutSeconds plus backoff. See LanguageModelOptions.cs for the full reasoning per field. Don't change these without re-measuring - each one broke the agent silently the first time and cost a full session to trace.
